name: Event calendar
description: Element type for an event calendar: month, week and list views, recurring events, categories with colours, registration with capacity and waiting list, e-mail confirmations and reminders, iCal export and subscription, and a macro for upcoming events.
author: Enterprise Wiki

permissions.label: See participants
permissions.description: See and export the participants of all events of the calendars in the category (organizers always see the participants of their own events).
